ios.desc:
More personal than a store-bought card. More convenient than going to the store. Make meaningful easy and send a real, personalized card to anyone in the world with TouchNote - straight from your phone. Rated 4.8 by over 199k customers, 4.4 out of 5 on Trustpilot, and over 1 million cards sent every year.

TouchNote handles the printing, postage, and worldwide delivery. We print locally in the destination country, so your card arrives faster wherever in the world you're sending. For example - order from the US to the UK? It's printed in the UK and delivered in days, not weeks. Birthday cards, anniversary cards, thank you cards, holiday cards - whatever the occasion, we'll get it there.

Because some moments deserve more than a text.

Here's how it works:

1) Pick a design from our collection of cards and gifts
2) Add your favourite photos and a personal message
3) We print it locally in your destination, stamp, and post it for you - worldwide

Send more than cards:

- Photo cards with your favourite memories
- Personalised gifts, delivered to their door
- Custom stamps, stickers, and photo cutouts
- Location maps and travel stickers

Every occasion, covered:
Beautiful designs for birthday cards, anniversary cards, thank you cards, Christmas cards, Father's Day cards, Mother's Day cards, wedding cards, Valentine's cards, and everyday surprises.

Join as a member for the best value, buy cards in advance with credit packs, or send individual cards. Worldwide delivery included.

Download TouchNote and send something real today.

quotes.text:
London, UK: Talented Android Developer

Touchnote is the world's most popular postcard-sending service (http://www.touchnote.com). Our Android Mobile Application Developer will create high profile mobile applications  such as Tochnote Postcards (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.touchnote.android) in a fast-paced working environment. We have small but talented development team where your contribution counts and your voice is heard, so you have a perfect chance to realise all your awazing ideas and grow professionally.

This role is for applicants in the UK only.

Essential skills:
- Strong familiarity with OOP, data structures/algorithms and design patterns.
- Proven experience of at least 2 years of end-to-end Android development from conceptualisation through to successful launch of an application in Google Play.
- Ability to develop UI-rich applications with strong user experience awareness and optimization.
- Strong attention to details, organisation and time management skills.
- Strong understanding of the latest features and development best practices for Android, including features in the latest SDKs, resource optimisation techniques and social network integration (e.g. Facebook or Google+)
- Fluent English

In return you get amazing team members and challenging tasks. Well,and Friday beers are on us.

If you're interested - please drop me an email to alex@touchnote.com
